description: Create column DamodaranIndustry at index 3 based on column Industry using expression grel:value

expression:
grel:if(
  isBlank(value),
  null,
  if(
    startsWith(value, "REIT - "),
    "R.E.I.T.",
    if(
      startsWith(value, "Drug Manufacturers"),
      "Drugs (Pharmaceutical)",
      if(
        contains(value.toLowercase(), "consumer electronics"),
        "Electronics (Consumer & Office)",
        if(
          startsWith(value, "Banks - "),
          if(
            contains(value, "Regional"),
            "Banks (Regional)",
            "Bank (Money Center)"
          ),
          if(
            contains(value, "retail"),
            "Retail (General)",
            if(
              contains(value.toLowercase(), "asset management"),
              "Investments & Asset Management",
              if(
                contains(value, "Communication Equipment"),
                "Telecom. Equipment",
                if(
                  contains(value, "Telecom Services"),
                  "Telecom. Services",
                  if(
                    contains(value, "Semiconductor Equipment"),
                    "Semiconductor Equip",
                    if(
                      contains(value, "Semiconductors"),
                      "Semiconductor",
                      if(
                        contains(value, "Medical Devices"),
                        "Healthcare Products",
                        if(
                          contains(value, "Medical Instruments & Supplies"),
                          "Healthcare Products",
                          if(
                            contains(value, "Healthcare Plans"),
                            "Healthcare Support Services",
                            if(
                              contains(value, "Medical Care Facilities"),
                              "Hospitals/Healthcare Facilities",
                              if(
                                contains(value, "Information Technology Services"),
                                "Information Services",
                                if(
                                  contains(value, "Advertising"),
                                  "Advertising",
                                  if(
                                    contains(value, "Aerospace & Defense"),
                                    "Aerospace/Defense",
                                    if(
                                      contains(value, "Airlines"),
                                      "Air Transport",
                                      if(
                                        contains(value, "Specialty Chemicals"),
                                        "Chemical (Specialty)",
                                        if(
                                          contains(value, "Packaged Foods"),
                                          "Food Processing",
                                          if(
                                            contains(value, "Household & Personal Products"),
                                            "Household Products",
                                            if(
                                              contains(value, "Insurance - Life"),
                                              "Insurance (Life)",
                                              if(
                                                contains(value, "Insurance - Property & Casualty"),
                                                "Insurance (Prop/Cas.)",
                                                if(
                                                  contains(value, "Insurance - Reinsurance"),
                                                  "Reinsurance",
                                                  if(
                                                    contains(value, "Insurance"),
                                                    "Insurance (General)",
                                                    if(
                                                      contains(value, "Oil & Gas E&P"),
                                                      "Oil/Gas (Production and Exploration)",
                                                      if(
                                                        contains(value, "Oil & Gas Integrated"),
                                                        "Oil/Gas (Integrated)",
                                                        if(
                                                          or(
                                                            contains(value, "Oil & Gas Midstream"),
                                                            contains(value, "Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing")
                                                          ),
                                                          "Oil/Gas Distribution",
                                                          if(
                                                            contains(value, "Oil & Gas Equipment & Services"),
                                                            "Oilfield Svcs/Equip.",
                                                            if(
                                                              contains(value, "Utilities - Regulated Water"),
                                                              "Utility (Water)",
                                                              if(
                                                                startsWith(value, "Utilities - "),
                                                                "Utility (General)",
                                                                if(
                                                                  contains(value, "Railroads"),
                                                                  "Transportation (Railroads)",
                                                                  if(
                                                                    contains(value, "Waste Management"),
                                                                    "Environmental & Waste Services",
                                                                    if(
                                                                      contains(value, "Scientific & Technical Instruments"),
                                                                      "Office Equipment & Services",
                                                                      if(
                                                                        contains(value, "Specialty Industrial Machinery"),
                                                                        "Machinery",
                                                                        if(
                                                                          contains(value, "Specialty Business Services"),
                                                                          "Business & Consumer Services",
                                                                          if(
                                                                            contains(value, "Specialty Retail"),
                                                                            "Retail (Special Lines)",
                                                                            if(
                                                                              contains(value, "Apparel Manufacturing"),
                                                                              "Apparel",
                                                                              if(
                                                                                contains(value, "Apparel Retail"),
                                                                                "Retail (Special Lines)",
                                                                                if(
                                                                                  contains(value, "Financial Data & Stock Exchanges"),
                                                                                  "Brokerage & Investment Banking",
                                                                                  if(
                                                                                    contains(value, "Credit Services"),
                                                                                    "Financial Svcs. (Non-bank & Insurance)",
                                                                                    if(
                                                                                      contains(value, "Biotechnology"),
                                                                                      "Drugs (Biotechnology)",
                                                                                      value
                                                                                    )
                                                                                  )
                                                                                )
                                                                              )
                                                                            )
                                                                          )
                                                                        )
                                                                      )
                                                                    )
                                                                  )
                                                                )
                                                              )
                                                            )
                                                          )
                                                        )
                                                      )
                                                    )
                                                  )
                                                )
                                              )
                                            )
                                          )
                                        )
                                      )
                                    )
                                  )
                                )
                              )
                            )
                          )
                        )
                      )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
)
